---
title: Callout label
format:
  mcanouil-typst:
    keep-typ: true
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    preset: quarto
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: The capital letters of the label of a quarto callout in Typst sit in the middle of its icon.
        check: bash _checks/pdf.sh callout-label quarto
---

::: {.callout-note}
Hazard ratios are adjusted for age and sex.
:::
